Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 59

“Objects fall away for the embodied one who abstains, but the taste for them remains. Even that taste falls away when the Supreme is seen.”

An honest account of why willpower alone stalls. Fasting removes the food, not the appetite; Krishna says only something more compelling can retire a craving for good.
